subject.title: [Feishu] Interactive Card message content parsing missing

question: What agent-visible payload contract should Feishu interactive cards use across direct inbound cards, card-action form/select callbacks, and merge_forward card sub-messages?
rationale: Source proves the direct inbound parser gap, but exposing card text, button values, selector values, and form fields consistently affects downstream agents and the Feishu plugin API shape.

options.title: Coordinate Narrow Plugin Fixes
options.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, land direct inbound parser reuse in the Feishu plugin, and let the callback-field and merge_forward issues own their narrower payload details.

options.title: Reduce Scope To Direct Inbound
options.body: Narrow this issue to direct `message_type: interactive` parsing and leave form/select callbacks plus merge_forward behavior entirely to existing linked items.

options.title: Defer Full Payloads
options.body: Pause broad parsing until maintainers decide agents should not receive full Feishu card or form payloads beyond existing text extraction.

recommendation.title: Coordinate Narrow Plugin Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, land direct inbound parser reuse in the Feishu plugin, and let the callback-field and merge_forward issues own their narrower payload details.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the community-maintained Feishu plugin contact, making them the best first routing point for the plugin payload contract.
